mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN t_skill s ON s.skill_id=f.skill_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id=p.user_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_revision r ON r.revision_id=s.public_revision_id AND r.skill_id=s.skill_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_version v ON v.version_id=s.current_version_id AND v.skill_id=s.skill_id AND v.version_type='RELEASE' LEFT JOIN t_skill_artifact a ON a.artifact_id=v.artifact_id
mapper.select: SELECT folder_id,COUNT(*) AS relation_count FROM t_skill_favorite WHERE user_id=#{userId} GROUP BY folder_id

SELECT f.favorite_id,f.skill_id,f.folder_id,f.saved_at, CASE WHEN f.folder_id=0 THEN '默认收藏夹' ELSE ff.name END AS folder_name, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS available, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.skill_id END AS public_skill_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.publisher_id END AS public_publisher_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.user_id END AS public_owner_user_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.handle END AS public_handle, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname),''),u.username) END AS public_public_name, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.slug END AS public_slug, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.name END AS public_name, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.summary END AS public_summary, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.category_id END AS public_category_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.revision_id END AS public_revision_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN v.version_id END AS public_version_id, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('v',v.release_number) END AS public_version_label, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN v.published_at END AS public_published_at, CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.source_type END AS public_source_type FROM t_skill_favorite f LEFT JOIN t_skill_favorite_folder ff ON ff.folder_id=f.folder_id AND ff.user_id=f.user_id
WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN AND r.revision_id IS NOT NULL THEN v.published_at END DESC, f.saved_at DESC,f.favorite_id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
